config.design: Eight new name-triple combinations x3 role rotations x2 givers xhome/work cue xbefore/after source =192 prompts. Matched distractor token, its absolute position, total length, final token and position within each pair.
hypotheses: Cue-before lowers harmful distractor reading if source-key availability limits this pathway.
Swapping the before-cue key into the after-cue receiver transfers the effect if key context is sufficient.
Query swaps may instead carry the change, or both operands may matter.
Deletion rescue transfers to these new prompts without fitting.
config.scope: Before/after clauses express analogous absence from market, but wording and syntax differ. This does not isolate a pure irrelevance concept. Real Q/K swaps affect other edges/destinations of that head. Deletion touches only distractor bus contribution at final destination.
config.selection: Head, source role and all conditions frozen before new evaluations; no case filtering.
